subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw add native Telegram sendMediaGroup album semantics now, and should maintainers port/review the existing external draft or request a fresh current-main implementation?
rationale: Current main already fixed multi-media fan-out as sequential sends, but native Telegram albums add new user-facing behavior and Telegram-specific constraints that automation should not choose without maintainer product direction.

options.title: Port or review album support
options.body: Accept the feature direction and have a maintainer review, port, or supersede the existing external draft against current main with live Telegram proof.

options.title: Keep sequential delivery only
options.body: Decide that the current mediaUrls fan-out is sufficient and close the album-specific request with that product rationale.

options.title: Defer to a broader media design
options.body: Keep this issue open but explicitly defer native albums until a broader outbound rich-media design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Port or review album support
recommendation.body: Accept the feature direction and have a maintainer review, port, or supersede the existing external draft against current main with live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already coordinated the prior cleanup review on this issue and identified the open implementation candidate as the maintainer follow-up path.
